categories.name: Farming Games
categories.content: Farming game allows players to simulate farming life, focusing on activities such as planting and harvesting crops, raising livestock, and managing resources.

categories.name: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities
categories.content: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities are RWAs that digitalize sovereign debt instruments and international money market funds outside of the United States such as German Bunds, UK Gilts, and sovereign-backed cash equivalents, to provide diversified international yield and institutional collateral on-chain.

categories.name: Etherfuse Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized sovereign debt (Stablebonds) issued by Etherfuse in compliance of CNBV regulation.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Camelot Launchpad
categories.content: Camelot Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Sun Pump Ecosystem
categories.content: Sun Pump Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via sunpump.meme.

categories.name: Quest-to-Earn
categories.content: Quest-to-Earn refers to a gamified system in which users complete specific tasks or challenges to earn rewards, which can be in the form of points, tokens, or other incentives.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: Olympus Pro Ecosystem
categories.content: Olympus Pro designed to provide liquidity management solutions for DeFi protocols. They offers a service called "bonds-as-a-service," which allows protocols to own their liquidity by offering discounted OHM tokens in exchange for liquidity provider (LP) tokens. This helps protocols to reduce their reliance on liquidity mining incentives and gain more control over their liquidity.

categories.name: TRON Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to the TRON network.

categories.name: Leveraged Token
categories.content: Leveraged crypto token is a type of financial instrument hat allows traders to amplify their exposure to the price movements of an underlying cryptocurrency.

categories.name: Orynth Ecosystem
categories.content: Projects launched via Orynth, designed to let users trade on the attention and interest surrounding early-stage software products and MVPs.

categories.name: Kumbaya Launchpad
categories.content: Kumbaya is a community-first DEX and launchpad designed as a high-performance hub for 'cult' tokens and cultural assets.

categories.name: OpenServ Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens launched on OpenServ, a multi-chain crowdfunding platform designed for autonomous startups and Agentic Applications (aApps) built on OpenServ’s AI reasoning infrastructure.

categories.name: Yoink.fun Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Yoink (https://yoinkai.fun/), an agentic launch and trading terminal on Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: Bankr Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens deployed through Bankr (https://bankr.bot/) via the Bankr Terminal, Bankr agent/API/CLI, or a @bankrbot social command.
